input.body:
# The lakehouse bundle: one nightly ingest job (declared in resources/), one declarative
# pipeline refining bronze into gold, deployed to a development and a production target.
bundle:
  name: lakehouse

include:
  - resources/*.yml

variables:
  catalog:
    description: The Unity Catalog everything below writes into.
    default: lakehouse_dev
  warehouse_id:
    description: The SQL warehouse the dashboard refresh runs on.
    default: "4b9b953939869799"

resources:
  pipelines:
    bronze_to_gold:
      name: Bronze to gold
      catalog: ${var.catalog}
      schema: gold
      serverless: true
      channel: CURRENT
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/bronze
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/silver
        - glob:
            include: transformations/gold/**
      notifications:
        - email_recipients:
            - data-eng@vrenken.eu
          alerts:
            - on-update-failure
            - on-update-fatal-failure

targets:
  dev:
    mode: development
    default: true
  prod:
    mode: production
    resources:
      pipelines:
        bronze_to_gold:
          catalog: lakehouse_prod
          serverless: false
      jobs:
        nightly_ingest:
          schedule:
            quartz_cron_expression: "0 0 2 * * ?"
